name: Zoey Day
source:
Zoey Day is Your Character's daughter. Although her default name is "Zoey", the player can choose to name her as they wish. Her appearance is dependent on which of the four character models the players chooses for Your Character.  She is first seen in Chapter 1.

Zoey is a bright and intelligent girl. As expected, she is shown to be upset and depressed after other kids bully her. She finds it hard to speak sometimes and freezes, but when she becomes more confident, she finds her voice. She also is a bit of a perfectionist; for example, spending more time fixing the stars on her ceiling because they were off by twenty degrees. She also believes in science, and since there is no evidence that ghosts are real, she doesn't believe in ghosts.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Daughter]Wiki[/url]]
